# Season7 The Nature Resort

> Season7 The Nature Resort is a nature stay in Chithirapuram, near Anachal in Munnar, Kerala, India.

## Official information

- Official website: https://www.season7resort.com/
- Address: Eatty City Road, Chithirapuram, PO, Anachal, Munnar, Kerala 685565, India
- Booking and availability: https://wa.me/918891747244
- Google Maps: https://share.google/q5DIH6NS6ARocP5l5
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/season7_the_nature_resort?stkn=NnVrcmt2cXYydTIy
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/share/14riSrmegjZ/?mibextid=wwXIfr

## About the resort

Season7 is a quiet Munnar resort surrounded by the green highlands of Kerala. The resort offers A/C and non A/C cottages, private balconies, mountain and valley views, en-suite bathrooms, modern amenities and complimentary breakfast.

Guests can enjoy a multi-cuisine restaurant, Cool Bar, swimming pool, spa and wellness time, kids play area, campfire nights and bicycle rides. Jeep safaris and nearby Munnar attractions can add adventure to a stay.

## Nearby places

- Wonder Valley Adventure Park
- Power House Waterfalls
- Chokramudi Peak
